name: bKash Customer App

summary: Features for the customer app of bKash, Bangladesh's largest mobile financial service, built in Flutter.
description: Mobile finance app of bKash, Bangladesh's largest mobile financial service. In the bKash partner team, 2021 to 2023, I built Bangla QR payments, Islamic Savings and the Pay Bill revamp with Flutter, BLoC and Clean Architecture.

Followed OOP, SOLID and Flutter performance best practices.
